runs.label: Arms 1–2c
runs.change: GRPO from the base model, then warm starts on DP-optimal schedules (SFT-200, then SoC-aware SFT-1,500), then up to 330 GRPO steps
runs.lesson: GRPO from the base never produced a valid schedule, so it had no reward to learn from. A warm start was needed, and one that spells out the state of charge took the model from 0.234 to 0.542 with no RL, and GRPO then reached 0.720.

runs.label: Run 1
runs.change: SoC-aware SFT on 1,500 solver schedules, then 330 steps of GRPO (TRL GRPOTrainer, vLLM)
runs.lesson: GRPO added +0.138 [+0.092, +0.185] on held-out days, its gains in the first ~100 steps; then the policy's entropy collapsed and up to 45% of GRPO groups had no reward spread.

runs.label: Run 2
runs.change: SFT on 10,000 solver schedules whose rationale states the DP's rule (SFT-10k), then 310 GRPO steps with adaptive and dynamic sampling
runs.lesson: Solver labels did the work: SFT-10k alone scored 0.841, +0.174 over run 1's warm start. GRPO on top stalled at −0.015 [−0.061, +0.030]: the policy was near-deterministic, so about half the days gave eight identical rollouts and no gradient.

runs.label: Confirmation
runs.change: No training: SFT-10k re-tested on 500 unseen days of 2014–2024 (eval-iid)
runs.lesson: Confirmed: 0.880 [0.858, 0.900] against the greedy rule's 0.751 [0.724, 0.777], intervals apart.

runs.label: Diagnostic
runs.change: No training: thinking mode on, and bigger untrained models (8B, 14B-AWQ)
runs.lesson: Neither helped. With thinking on, no base model finished reasoning within 4,096 tokens (0 of 800 completions); untrained 8B answered all-idle (0.200) and 14B-AWQ scored 0.146; SFT-10k with thinking on fell to 0.291.

runs.label: Run 3
runs.change: From SFT-10k, 300 steps of policy gradient with the DP's exact per-hour advantage A_t = Q*(s_t, a_t) − V*(s_t) in place of GRPO's group baseline
runs.lesson: Held-out reward rose +0.041 [+0.011, +0.072] (primary met) and +0.039 on eval-iid, through fewer broken schedules: every suboptimal hour carries a signal, even when all rollouts agree.

runs.label: Run 4 (blind)
runs.change: From run 3, forecast-then-plan on the blind tier: SFT on a teacher forecaster's written forecast and the DP plan on it (12,500 rows), then the same exact-advantage RL on the plan
runs.lesson: Its written forecasts are close to the teacher's (MAE 9.79 against 9.53 $/MWh), and the DP on them would score 0.907, level with Sol's 0.903. Its own schedules score 0.828: the 4B loses its score in planning.

glance.label: of the hindsight optimum captured, before → after training
glance.text: Qwen3-4B bidding blind on 331 battery-days it never saw (18–27 Oct 2026); 0.16 → 0.83 on 300 held-out days of 2025. Doing nothing scores 0.2.

glance.label: of GPT-6 Luna at high effort, for the same score
glance.text: 0.841 against 0.836, paired +0.005 [−0.036, +0.044], for $0.00047 against $0.0020 a battery-day. GPT-6.1 Sol scores 0.072 more for 33× the cost.

glance.label: per MW of battery power a year, bought by training
glance.text: From −$14.1k, worse than idle, to $27.1k on ERCOT's day-ahead prices of 2025: about $4.1M a year for a 100 MW battery. Still $3.4k below persistence-DP, a free heuristic.

glance.label: held-out reward from exact DP advantages, where GRPO stalled
glance.text: Registered run 3: +0.041 [+0.011, +0.072] over its warm start, to 0.885. GRPO from the same start: −0.015 [−0.061, +0.030].
